messages.plaintextBody:
James,

v3 attached. Changes are limited: a £9m first-year floor on the liability cap (clause 15.3), and we've accepted James's drafting on OTIF moving to 97.5% for the first six months post rate-readiness, 98% thereafter. Everything else is agreed. If Halstead is content we can finalise the execution version for signature next week.

Adam
